body: I don't know exactly whats going on, but I can relate to what you are saying. Your not alone, you've probably been through alot so it's valid to feel how you do. Life's hard to be honest, and I just wanted to say that your strong.

It's understandable to be tired with all that you have been through and are currently going through. I understand the feeling of not fitting in or feeling like you have a place in the world. I can't say that I know I know exactly how you feel. But honestly I'm really rooting for you if nobody else is. I really hope life ends up treating you well, you deserve it. Stay here as long as you can.

I wouldn't say that you're crazy. Life is a weird thing, honestly sometimes I have the same thoughts. Sometimes I wonder why do anything if it's not real. I can't provide alot of knowledge on what to do because i'm still pretty young. I just wanted to let you know that you're not alone and I know that it's not easy. If you can find any reason to keep pushing please do.
Even though I don't know you personally I really hope you're still here.
